title: Watch Mehdi Call Out ‘Charlatan’ Haley Stevens on ‘Piers Morgan Uncensored’
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Zeteo's editor-in-chief **Mehdi Hasan** joined '**Piers Morgan Uncensored** '
live on set in Washington, DC, today to set the record straight on the
allegedly antisemitic campaign ad that Haley Stevens used as her excuse for
un-endorsing Abdul El-Sayed and backing Michigan's Republican Senate
candidate, Mike Rogers.

"**This was ginned up as a fake controversy by Haley Stevens, the charlatan …
as an excuse for her doing what she was going to do anyways**," Mehdi tells
**Piers**. He adds, "**This idea that she joined Mike Rogers because of an ad
that Abdul El-Sayed had nothing to do with is insane**."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Mehdi rightly points out that the _real scandal_ is the "**old school white
supremacist stuff** " coming from the White House, including the Islamophobic
attacks against El-Sayed, the president's recent use of an antisemitic slur,
and the racist Halloween post by Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins.

"**They 're losing. The economy is bad so they go immediately to racism,
Islamophobia, and that's why this ad is such a red herring**," Mehdi says.
"**This was always about Haley Stevens making an insane decision to jump
ship**."

Watch the full debate on 'Piers Uncensored' above. Mehdi comes on at around
**20 minutes and 50 seconds**.
